attendance.policyHelp: Set subject thresholds. An alert appears when the absence count, percentage, or both are reached. Leave a field empty to disable that threshold; if you choose both, configure both fields. Excused absences remain in the history but do not count toward the threshold. Alerts do not yet affect grades, reports, or promotion.

attendance.policyGuidePrompt: Questions about thresholds, late arrivals, or accumulation?
attendance.policyGuide.count.title: Absence threshold
attendance.policyGuide.count.body: This is the number of equivalent absences that triggers an alert. A threshold of 4 triggers on the fourth absence, not the fifth. Leave it blank to disable this criterion.
attendance.policyGuide.percent.title: Absence rate threshold (%)
attendance.policyGuide.percent.body: Calculated as 100 × equivalent absences ÷ marked class slots for this subject and selected term or year. Future dates and unmarked cells do not count. The displayed rate may be rounded, but comparison uses the exact value. Leave it blank to disable it.
attendance.policyGuide.combination.title: Combining thresholds
attendance.policyGuide.combination.body: Either threshold triggers an alert when any configured threshold is reached. Both requires both thresholds to be set and reached. With neither set, no alert appears.
attendance.policyGuide.scope.title: Accumulation
attendance.policyGuide.scope.body: Per term counts only marked class slots in that term; per year accumulates them for the school year. Each explicit timetable slot counts separately: missing two slots of the same subject means two absences.
attendance.policyGuide.late.title: Late arrivals per absence
attendance.policyGuide.late.body: This is the number of late arrivals equivalent to one absence, not minutes late. At 3, five late arrivals count as one equivalent absence with two left toward the next conversion. At 0, late arrivals remain in history but do not count as absences.
attendance.policyGuide.excused.title: Excused absences
attendance.policyGuide.excused.body: An approved excuse remains in the history and marked-slot total but no longer adds to sanctionable absences. A pending request does not change the count yet.
attendance.policyGuide.example.title: Full example
attendance.policyGuide.example.body: Two absences and six late arrivals, with three late arrivals per absence, make four equivalent absences. Across 20 marked class slots, that is 20%. A threshold of four absences or 20% is reached exactly here.
attendance.policyGuide.effect.title: What happens when an alert appears?
attendance.policyGuide.effect.body: The alert is provisional so staff can review the case. It does not currently change grades, reports, or promotion automatically.
